column1: # ZAP keys rules by id only: a rule for one variant of a rule, by its alert
# reference ("10055-6"), follows "#!", which ZAP skips as a comment and the
# gate reads (scripts/zap_findings.py).
# scripts/zap_gate.py decides the job, not ZAP's own WARN output: every
# Medium or High finding fails unless it is IGNOREd here or all its
# addresses are out of scope by a reviewed pattern, and any finding of a
# FAIL rule fails at any risk (SECURITY.md, "Dynamic scan").
# Change this file only with a reason a reviewer can check against the code,
# and name the review in the commit. The scans run over plain http with
# COOKIE_SECURE=false (docker compose), so the https-only rules (HSTS, the
# Secure cookie flag) are left to the header tests
# (tests/security/test_api_security_headers.py, web/e2e/security.spec.ts).
# The headers every answer of the cabinet (web/next.config.ts, web/src/proxy.ts)
# and of the API (app/gateways/http/middleware/security_headers_middleware.py)
# promise: one missing anywhere fails, whatever ZAP's risk.

column4: Reviewed 2026-10-23: React renders style attributes, which a style nonce would block, so styles keep 'unsafe-inline' (web/src/server/contentSecurityPolicy.ts; the widget demo page likewise). Scripts run only with the page's nonce and 'strict-dynamic'.

column1: # Reviewed 2026-10-23: the website widget is embedded on any business's own
# site, so /widget.js and the widget's routes answer every origin
# (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, app/gateways/http/widget_cors_middleware.py).
# They take no cookies and no bearer token, only the visitor's own session
# key, so no credentialed read crosses origins.
# Reviewed 2026-10-23: the embed code (/widget.js's own example and the
# owner's snippet route) loads the widget without an integrity hash on
# purpose: the script is evergreen, a fixed hash would break every installed
# widget at the next release. Its origin is the platform's own API.
# Reviewed 2026-10-23: the owner's own business routes return the business's
# customers' phone numbers by design (bearer token, business scope, row-level
# security). The rule reads a seeded number such as 4915112345678
# (+49 151 1234 5678) as a card number. Cards never reach the platform:
# payments run on the payment providers' hosted pages.
